description: Figure 16 is a grouped bar chart that displays the average Shapley values for three different models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green)—across various relative positions to a probed target word. The horizontal axis lists these relative positions, which include L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+. The vertical axis, labeled "Shapley value," ranges from 0 to 80. The chart shows that the Shapley values are highest for the "T" position, where the chLSTM model has the highest value, exceeding 80, while the mBERT and XLM-R models have values around 60 and 55, respectively. For all other positions, the Shapley values are significantly lower, generally below 20, with the values for mBERT and XLM-R being very similar and the chLSTM values being slightly lower or comparable. The values for the "T" position are substantially higher than for any other position, indicating a strong contribution to the model's output when the target word is at the center.
